item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • Sign in to RevenueCat with one click. A new browser-based sign-in replaces the per-project API-key paste flow. One sign-in covers every iOS app on your account, and ADSwift auto-matches each app to its RevenueCat project by bundle id. Existing users will see a one-time reconnect prompt on first launch — your campaigns and revenue history are preserved.
  • App ↔︎ project mappings table in Settings → Connections → RevenueCat. Edit per-app, sign out, or jump to RevenueCat to revoke access globally.
  • Multi-currency support. Spend, revenue, and proceeds in non-USD campaigns are now converted to USD using daily ECB rates. A new toolbar status pill shows when FX is active and when rates last refreshed.
  • Rev/Install and Net/Install alongside CPA in campaign, ad group, and keyword detail views — see what each install is actually worth, and whether you’re net-positive after spend.
  • Revenue overlay on the Spend chart. Attributed revenue now plots on top of daily spend so you can see profitability at a glance.
  • Trials column in the campaign, ad group, and keyword tables (visible by default, with a hover caveat explaining trial attribution).
  • Attribution coverage badge on detail views — surfaces what fraction of installs in the selected window have RevenueCat-attributed revenue, so partial coverage is visible instead of silently lowering Rev/Install.
  • Menu bar revenue widget. A small MenuBarExtra shows today’s RC-attributed revenue across all connected apps with a 7-day sparkline, toggleable from Settings.
  • Screenshot disguise mode — toolbar eye icon (or ⌘⇧D) hides app names, icons, and campaign names so you can share screenshots without revealing real account data.
  • Identifiers chevron on detail views — click to reveal Apple Ads campaign/ad group/keyword IDs without permanently cluttering the layout.
  • First-run banner explains why Rev/Install is empty for fresh RevenueCat integrations until backfill completes.

Changed

  • “Source” filter renamed to “Placements” to match the table column header.
  • ROI color in detail headers now uses the same green/red threshold as the table column so Net/Install and ROI agree at a glance.
